items.name: WindowUDFFieldArgs
items.summary: Metadata for defining the result field from evaluating a user-defined window function.

methods.name: get_input_field
methods.summary: Returns `Some(Field)` of input expression at index, otherwise returns `None` if the index is out of bounds.

methods.name: input_fields
methods.summary: Returns the field of input expressions passed as arguments to the user-defined window function.

methods.name: name
methods.summary: Returns the name for the field of the final result of evaluating the user-defined window function.
